the Paleozoic, Mesozoic and Cenozoic formations of this innermost segment of Western Carpathians were not affected by any Hercynian, Vardarian or Alpine orogeny.
the Bükkium is not a Hercynian, but a Tertiary mountain belt.

the Paleozoic, Mesozoic and Paleogene formations of the Bükks experienced a low-grade orogenic metamorphism in the Late Cretaceous and Early Tertiary, followed by a rapid cooling and exhumation of the Bükk Plateau during the Miocene.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the Paleozoic, Mesozoic, and Cenozoic tectonic and thermal events in the Bükkium were not synchronous.
the Paleozoic formations were metamorphosed in the Dinaric type orogenic system, and the Mesozoic formations were affected by a separate metamorphic event in the Alpine type orogenic system.
